notes.GLP1-009-PCP-001:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 09/06/2025

S: 55 y/o F, would like to lose weight; knees and back ache more, and she has gained steadily since menopause. Snacks late at night; frequent takeout since kids left home. Has a gym membership through retirement community center.

O: Wt 83.9 kg, Ht 165 cm, BMI 30.8. BP 126/79.
Exam unremarkable.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 30.8 — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1800 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 5 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program; RD intake scheduled.
 Follow-up in ~3–4 months.
2. Low back pain — chronic, stable; strengthening at gym encouraged.
